supporting_observations.claim: The listed WS-TWEBER-01 network records show connections to 10.51.20.30:8080 at several times within the alert window; these are recorded as HTTP connections, not direct HTTPS connections.

The observed connections to 10.51.20.30:8080 are consistent with use of the organization's explicit proxy, but the available records do not reveal the ultimate destination or whether the proxied traffic used HTTPS.
The listed TLS records involving WS-TWEBER-01 show other internal hosts initiating connections to it, rather than WS-TWEBER-01 making the outbound connections described by the alert.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon collection for WS-TWEBER-01 was unavailable during 13:20–14:20 UTC, so process and endpoint events for the alerted host cannot be reviewed.
Proxy collection for PROXY-PIN-01 was unavailable during 13:20–14:20 UTC, preventing inspection of proxied destinations, URLs, or CONNECT/TLS details.
The available WS-TWEBER-01 proxy-directed records identify the proxy IP and port but do not identify the application or the external destination.

Correlate the alert's underlying connection records with the proxy and endpoint records to verify cadence and destination.
